description: This is a Python source file defining an API module for version 1 of a branding compliance backend. It uses FastAPI to declare routes for managing jobs, uploading assets, running analysis, fixing issues, and retrieving results. The file includes route handlers, request/response models, helper functions, and imports from internal services and models, illustrating its core role in exposing backend functionalities related to branding compliance operations.

classes.name: CreateJobRequest
classes.description: Request model for creating a new job with optional owner, title, and description.

classes.name: CreateJobResponse
classes.description: Response model containing the ID of a newly created job.

classes.name: StatusResponse
classes.description: Model representing the status and progress details of a job.

classes.name: FixAssetRequest
classes.description: Request model for fixing a single asset with an optional strategy.

classes.name: BatchFixRequest
classes.description: Request model for performing batch fixes across multiple assets.

methods.name: create_job(data: CreateJobRequest, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Handler to create a new job, generate a UUID, initialize workspace, and store job state.

methods.name: delete_job(job_id: str, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Handler to delete a job and its workspace directory.

methods.name: None _save_upload_to(path: Path, file: UploadFile)
methods.description: Utility function to save uploaded files atomically.

methods.name: upload_assets_zip(job_id: str, file: UploadFile = File(...), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Handler to upload a zip archive of assets, extract it, and update the job status.

methods.name: upload_old_brand(job_id: str, file: UploadFile = File(...), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Handler to upload an old brand image for analysis.

methods.name: upload_new_brand(job_id: str, file: UploadFile = File(...), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Handler to upload a new brand image for fixing overlays.

methods.name: analyze_job(job_id: str, background: BackgroundTasks, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Starts background analysis and preview generation for a specific job.

methods.name: get_status(job_id: str, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Returns current status and progress details for a job.

methods.name: get_results(job_id: str, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Lists assets and issues associated with a job, including summary.

methods.name: get_asset_preview( job_id: str, asset_id: str, view: Literal["original", "overlay", "fixed"] = Query("original", description="Preview type"), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store), )
methods.description: Provides a preview file for an asset in original, overlay, or fixed view.

methods.name: fix_single_asset(job_id: str, asset_id: str, req: FixAssetRequest, request: Request, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Runs an automatic fix for a specific asset and returns the output.

methods.name: batch_fix(job_id: str, req: BatchFixRequest, request: Request, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Performs automatic fixes across multiple assets with issues.

methods.name: download_artifacts( job_id: str, type: Literal["zip", "report", "both"] = Query("zip", description="Artifact type to download"), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store), )
methods.description: Creates and serves ZIP or report files for download.
